editors.name: prompt-cinematic-colorist
editors.specialty: translate only the supplied language into a decisive production-ready cinematic grade; separately plan black floor, shadow and midtone color, neutral axis, highlight shoulder, saturation hierarchy and local depth; never assume an external reference image

editors.name: prompt-palette-designer
editors.specialty: make the prompt's named palette, warm-cool separation, tonal hierarchy and genre cues clearly visible while avoiding a uniform global cast, semantic recoloring, monochrome collapse or excessive strength

editors.name: prompt-continuity-colorist
editors.specialty: preserve content, skin, neutral objects, texture and recoverable shadow/highlight detail while keeping one coherent prompt-driven grade across the entire shot; allow a strong visible change when it remains technically clean

evaluators.name: prompt-fulfillment-critic
evaluators.focus: literal fulfillment of the supplied color-grading language, including the requested black floor, shadow and midtone palette, warm-cool relationship, saturation hierarchy, highlight roll-off, depth and genre mood; also require preserved content, plausible materials, clean skin and neutrals, stable frames and no clipping, haze or timid near-identity result
